knockout.description: Party knockout/revive copy (LIV-41/LIV-44). {member} is a display name, {floor} a floor number; never catalog ids. The Game Designer owns the final wording/tuning.
knockout.partyWipeBody: The last of your party falls on Floor {floor}. The Temple of the Dawn draws you back and restores you at the tower gate.

visuals.description: Phase 4 knockout/revive presentation (LIV-45; downed treatment re-specced LIV-49). Behavior lives in party_ai.revive (enabled/color/pulseHz/radius); these are the geometry + palette tokens the renderers read. `downed` authors a near-full grayscale: `desaturate` mixes each palette colour toward its Rec.709 luminance (`luminance` weights), `darken` then multiplies the result, and `tint`/`tintAmount` apply a final cool wash; `rotationDeg` lays the body on its back about the tile centre. The beacon is the E1 'Call for Help' ring; the channel tokens draw the revive tether + progress arc.

swap.description: Control-swap feedback (LIV-49). Data-only tokens for the KO handoff beat, the fluid position/camera move, and the destination activity flash. `beatMs` is the input-locked dramatic hold at a KO handoff before control transfers (the world keeps simulating; only the incoming actor's input is held). Position and camera interpolate over their `*Ms` with the shared `easing`. The destination flash ramps to `peakAlpha` then eases out over `durationMs`, paired with a locator ring; `mode: additive` lightens the destination sprite. `reducedMotion` collapses the beat + animations and dims the flash to a single frame. Cue names resolve through sounds.json.

party.description: Auto-ally feedback copy (FIX-11 / LIV-26). {member}, {level}, {cards}, {item} and {ability} are substituted with display names, never catalog ids. Cues are subtle and non-blocking; no dark patterns.

pause.description: The pause menu does not offer a direct town return; use the tower's stair exits or Tower Gate.

floatingText.description: Pickup/chest messages spawn staggered around the player and live longer than combat numbers.

lootPlacement.description: Dropped items sort to the nearest empty walkable tile, expanding ring by ring from the drop point; stacking happens only when no free tile remains in range.

debug.description: Debug toggles (default off). Walk Thru Walls lets the active member step onto any in-bounds tile, including walls. Tester's Strength reduces all incoming attack and damage-over-time damage by testerStrengthDamageReductionPct.
